capabilities: Grant scoped read/write folder access via a searchable visual folder picker
Switch between Protected, Autonomous, and Full management access profiles
Preview and confirm each protected write before it is applied
Perform atomic managed note edits, frontmatter changes, renames, moves, and trash through authenticated one-time requests
Record operations in an audit log with recovery backups and rollback on partial failures
disambiguation: Not a general file-permission manager; it gates access only for the Obsidian Bridge companion app.
extras: Desktop-only plugin; managed operations require Obsidian 1.12.7 or later, the official CLI enabled, and the matching Obsidian Bridge 0.5.8 release. README states the project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to give an external tool limited, user-controlled read and write access to specific vault folders.

relations.evidence: Bridge Control is the desktop-only Obsidian companion for Obsidian Bridge.

summary: Permission-control companion for Obsidian Bridge that grants an external AI bridge scoped local read/write access through profiles and confirmed managed operations.
